column1: # Rows db.ps7c.ps.* (line PS, PS7c): psiblast -in_pssm of text PSSMs whose finalData Karlin-Altschul values are PLUS-INFINITY, MINUS-INFINITY or NOT-A-NUMBER (the rnd PSSM of ps7_*, tests/db_search/paja, -comp_based_stats 0 -evalue 1000), and of a PSSM query whose Seq-inst length is one less than its letters; round 2 and the PSSM files with pssm-both. Freeze them alone with `freeze --program psiblast --only db.ps7c.`.
